mergedParams.userDescription: Inverted colors and psychedelic palettes. internal effects for text, video, images

output.title: Psychedelic Inverted Colors - Internal Effects Pack

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'psychedelic-hue-shift' that continuously rotates through inverted color palettes using CSS hue-rotate and invert filters. The effect should animate through a full 360-degree hue rotation while simultaneously pulsing the invert filter between 0% and 100%, creating a mesmerizing color transformation. Accept parameters for rotation duration (default 4s), invert pulse speed (default 2s), and initial hue offset. Use generic AnimationRange arrays with smooth easing curves. The effect should target any component type (text, video, or image) via targetIds and apply GPU-accelerated filter transformations. Include a subtle brightness oscillation between 0.8 and 1.2 to enhance the psychedelic effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: filter with hue-rotate(0-360deg), invert(0-1), brightness(0.8-1.2). AnimationRange structure: [{key:'filter', val:'hue-rotate(0deg) invert(0) brightness(1)', prog:0}, {key:'filter', val:'hue-rotate(90deg) invert(0.5) brightness(0.8)', prog:0.25}, {key:'filter', val:'hue-rotate(180deg) invert(1) brightness(1.2)', prog:0.5}, {key:'filter', val:'hue-rotate(270deg) invert(0.5) brightness(0.8)', prog:0.75}, {key:'filter', val:'hue-rotate(360deg) invert(0) brightness(1)', prog:1}]. Easing: ease-in-out. Mode: provider. Input params: z.object({duration: z.number().default(4000), invertSpeed: z.number().default(2000), hueOffset: z.number().default(0), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: AnimationRange[], easing: 'ease-in-out'}]}

prompts.prompt: Build a waveform-reactive internal effect preset named 'bass-invert-glitch' that inverts colors based on bass frequencies in the audio. When bass hits exceed a threshold, trigger rapid invert filter toggles creating a strobing psychedelic effect. The effect should also apply random RGB channel shifts synchronized with the beat, splitting colors into prismatic fragments. Include parameters for bass sensitivity (0-1), invert intensity, and color channel separation amount. The effect should react in real-time to audio analysis, creating dynamic visual distortions that pulse with the music's low frequencies.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (audio-reactive). Waveform configuration: {type: 'custom', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.8, threshold: 0.6}. Effect properties: filter with invert() and custom RGB channel manipulation via CSS filters. Mode: provider with targetIds. Input params: z.object({bassSensitivity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.8), invertIntensity: z.number().default(1), channelSeparation: z.number().default(10), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [{type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, props: {filter: (bassValue) => `invert(${bassValue > threshold ? invertIntensity : 0}) sepia(${bassValue * 0.5}) hue-rotate(${bassValue * 180}deg)`}, audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: params.bassSensitivity}]}

prompts.prompt: Design a combined internal effect preset 'kaleidoscope-morph' that layers multiple psychedelic transformations. First layer: animate through complementary color inversions using hue-rotate from 0 to 180 degrees. Second layer: apply a pulsing contrast filter that oscillates between high contrast (200%) and inverted low contrast (50%). Third layer: add a subtle rotation transform that slowly spins the element. Accept parameters for morph duration, contrast intensity, rotation speed, and whether to include a rainbow gradient overlay. Each layer should have different timing to create complex, evolving visual patterns.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: combined (multiple generic effects). Three effect layers: 1) Hue rotation: AnimationRange for hue-rotate(0-180deg) with ease-in-out. 2) Contrast pulse: AnimationRange for contrast(50%-200%) with ease-in-out, offset timing. 3) Rotation: AnimationRange for rotate(0-360deg) linear. Input params: z.object({morphDuration: z.number().default(6000), contrastIntensity: z.number().default(2), rotationSpeed: z.number().default(0.1), includeGradient: z.boolean().default(false), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: hueRanges, duration: morphDuration}, {type: 'generic', ranges: contrastRanges, duration: morphDuration/2}, {type: 'generic', ranges: rotationRanges, duration: morphDuration*2}]}

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal effect preset 'neon-negative' that creates an inverted neon glow effect for text elements. Invert the original colors while adding animated text-shadow layers in complementary psychedelic hues (cyan, magenta, yellow). The shadows should pulse and shift positions creating a vibrating neon sign effect. Include parameters for glow intensity, shadow spread, animation speed, and color palette selection (psychedelic, vaporwave, or acid). The effect should use GPU-accelerated transforms and maintain smooth 60fps performance even with multiple shadow layers.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: filter: invert(1), textShadow with multiple animated layers. AnimationRange: [{key:'textShadow', val:'0 0 10px cyan, 2px 2px 20px magenta, -2px -2px 30px yellow', prog:0}, {key:'textShadow', val:'2px 0 15px magenta, -2px 2px 25px yellow, 0 -2px 35px cyan', prog:0.5}, {key:'textShadow', val:'0 0 10px cyan, 2px 2px 20px magenta, -2px -2px 30px yellow', prog:1}]. Additional filter animation for invert pulsing. Input params: z.object({glowIntensity: z.number().default(1), shadowSpread: z.number().default(20), animationSpeed: z.number().default(2000), colorPalette: z.enum(['psychedelic', 'vaporwave', 'acid']).default('psychedelic'), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: shadowRanges, duration: animationSpeed}, {type: 'generic', ranges: invertRanges, duration: animationSpeed/2}]}

prompts.prompt: Create a frequency-reactive internal effect preset 'spectrum-invert' that maps audio frequency bands to color inversion zones. Divide the visual into horizontal or vertical strips, each reacting to different frequency ranges (bass, low-mid, mid, high-mid, treble). When frequencies peak, their corresponding strips invert colors creating a dynamic barcode-like psychedelic pattern. Include parameters for strip orientation (horizontal/vertical), frequency sensitivity per band, and inversion smoothing. The effect should use CSS clip-path or mask techniques for strip isolation.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (multi-band audio-reactive). Waveform configuration: Multiple frequency bands with individual sensitivity. Properties: Dynamic clip-path regions with invert filters. Implementation: Create 5 effect instances, each targeting different frequency ranges. Input params: z.object({orientation: z.enum(['horizontal', 'vertical']).default('horizontal'), bassSensitivity: z.number().default(0.9), midSensitivity: z.number().default(0.7), trebleSensitivity: z.number().default(0.8), smoothing: z.number().default(0.2), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: frequencyBands.map((band, i) => ({type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds, props: {filter: (val) => `invert(${val > 0.5 ? 1 : 0})`, clipPath: getStripClipPath(i, orientation)}, audioProperty: band, sensitivity: getSensitivity(band)})}

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset 'chromatic-aberration-invert' that simulates psychedelic chromatic aberration with color inversion. Split RGB channels and offset them with different transforms while applying selective inversion to each channel. Animate the channel separation distance and inversion intensity to create a breathing, prismatic effect. Parameters should control aberration strength, animation speed, inversion pattern (all channels, alternating, or random), and whether to include a color temperature shift. Use CSS filters and transforms for GPU optimization.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: Multiple filter layers for RGB channel manipulation using drop-shadow and color matrix filters. AnimationRange: Channel separation via translateX/Y offsets combined with color filters. [{key:'filter', val:'invert(0) drop-shadow(2px 0 0 red) drop-shadow(-2px 0 0 cyan)', prog:0}, {key:'filter', val:'invert(1) drop-shadow(5px 0 0 magenta) drop-shadow(-5px 0 0 green)', prog:0.5}, {key:'filter', val:'invert(0) drop-shadow(2px 0 0 red) drop-shadow(-2px 0 0 cyan)', prog:1}]. Input params: z.object({aberrationStrength: z.number().default(5), animationSpeed: z.number().default(3000), inversionPattern: z.enum(['all', 'alternating', 'random']).default('alternating'), includeTemperatureShift: z.boolean().default(true), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: aberrationRanges, duration: animationSpeed, easing: 'ease-in-out'}]}

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset 'solarize-wave' that creates a solarization effect with animated threshold values, producing psychedelic partial color inversions. The effect should wave through the image/video like a scanner, inverting colors based on brightness thresholds that oscillate. Include secondary color curves that shift hues toward complementary palettes. Parameters for wave speed, solarization intensity, threshold range, and color shift amount. The scanning wave should be visible as a subtle gradient mask that travels across the element.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: combined (generic + mask animation). Properties: CSS filter with custom solarize effect using contrast, invert, and hue-rotate. Mask gradient animation for wave effect. AnimationRange for threshold: [{key:'filter', val:'invert(0.5) contrast(2) hue-rotate(0deg)', prog:0}, {key:'filter', val:'invert(0.8) contrast(0.5) hue-rotate(180deg)', prog:0.5}, {key:'filter', val:'invert(0.5) contrast(2) hue-rotate(360deg)', prog:1}]. Mask animation: linear-gradient moving across element. Input params: z.object({waveSpeed: z.number().default(2000), solarizeIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.7), thresholdMin: z.number().default(0.3), thresholdMax: z.number().default(0.8), colorShift: z.number().default(180), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: solarizeRanges}, {type: 'generic', ranges: maskRanges}]}

prompts.prompt: Create a beat-synchronized internal effect preset 'strobe-negative' that flashes between normal and inverted colors on musical beats, with psychedelic color transitions during the flash. The strobe should have variable intensity based on beat strength, with stronger beats triggering fuller inversions and color shifts. Add motion blur during transitions to create trailing effects. Parameters for strobe sensitivity, color shift range, blur intensity, and flash duration. Include an 'acid mode' that adds random hue rotations on each beat.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (beat-reactive). Waveform configuration: {type: 'beat', audioProperty: 'transient', threshold: 0.7}. Properties: Rapid filter transitions with invert(), hue-rotate(), and blur(). Beat detection triggers state changes. Input params: z.object({strobeSensitivity: z.number().default(0.8), colorShiftRange: z.number().default(180), blurIntensity: z.number().default(2), flashDuration: z.number().default(100), acidMode: z.boolean().default(false), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [{type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds, props: {filter: (beatValue) => beatValue > threshold ? `invert(1) hue-rotate(${acidMode ? Math.random() * 360 : colorShiftRange}deg) blur(${blurIntensity}px)` : 'invert(0) blur(0)'}, audioProperty: 'transient', sensitivity: strobeSensitivity}]}

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal effect preset 'liquid-invert' that creates a fluid, lava lamp-like color inversion effect. Use animated SVG filters (turbulence and displacement) to create organic, flowing regions of inverted colors that morph and blend. The psychedelic palette shifts through complementary colors while the liquid boundaries undulate. Parameters for flow speed, turbulence intensity, inversion coverage percentage, and color cycle speed. The effect should feel organic and hypnotic, like looking through a kaleidoscope filled with liquid mercury.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic with SVG filter reference. Properties: SVG feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap + feComponentTransfer for selective inversion. AnimationRange for turbulence baseFrequency and displacement scale. [{key:'filter', val:'url(#liquid-filter) invert(0.5)', prog:0}, {key:'filter', val:'url(#liquid-filter) invert(1) hue-rotate(90deg)', prog:0.33}, {key:'filter', val:'url(#liquid-filter) invert(0.5) hue-rotate(180deg)', prog:0.66}, {key:'filter', val:'url(#liquid-filter) invert(0)', prog:1}]. SVG filter animates turbulence seed for flowing effect. Input params: z.object({flowSpeed: z.number().default(3000), turbulenceIntensity: z.number().default(0.02), inversionCoverage: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.6), colorCycleSpeed: z.number().default(5000), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: {svg: ['liquid-filter']}}. Return: {effects: [{type: 'generic', ranges: liquidRanges, duration: flowSpeed}]}

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset 'prismatic-split' that breaks images/videos into triangular prisms with different inversion and color states, creating a shattered stained-glass psychedelic effect. Each prism region should have its own color transformation - some fully inverted, others with hue shifts, creating a fragmented kaleidoscope. Animate the prism boundaries to shift and reorganize. Parameters for prism count, animation style (breathing, rotating, shifting), color variation intensity, and whether to include iridescent rainbow edges between prisms.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic with clip-path animations. Properties: Multiple clip-path polygons with individual filter states. Implementation: Generate N triangular regions via clip-path, each with unique filter combinations. AnimationRange for each prism: [{key:'clipPath', val:initialPolygon, prog:0}, {key:'clipPath', val:morphedPolygon, prog:0.5}, {key:'clipPath', val:initialPolygon, prog:1}] combined with [{key:'filter', val:'invert(0)', prog:0}, {key:'filter', val:'invert(1) hue-rotate(120deg)', prog:0.5}, {key:'filter', val:'invert(0.5) hue-rotate(240deg)', prog:1}]. Input params: z.object({prismCount: z.number().min(3).max(12).default(6), animationStyle: z.enum(['breathing', 'rotating', 'shifting']).default('breathing'), colorVariation: z.number().default(1), iridescentEdges: z.boolean().default(true), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: prisms.map(p => ({type: 'generic', ranges: p.ranges, duration: 4000, targetIds}))}
